title: Deloitte Survey: Mid-Market, Private Companies Capitalize on Technology to Tap New Business Potential
主要内容: Deloitte's 2017 report highlights increased technology investment among mid-market and private companies, with over a third spending more than 5% of revenue on tech resources. This marks the highest level of investment seen to date. The report emphasizes that technology enables agility and business opportunities, particularly for smaller firms. Digital capabilities are reshaping business models and priorities across industries. 34% of companies prioritize customer intimacy in social platform strategies. 58% use data analytics for sales and customer management. 62% of firms using machine intelligence believe it helps analyze business outcomes. Big data, information security, and cloud integration are seen as key for productivity. Cloud adoption continues to rise among private and mid-market firms. 65% use data analytics to improve forecasting and reporting accuracy. Mixed reality is being tested by two-thirds of mid-market respondents for business goals. Over 30% are in deployment stage, with 52% using it operationally. Technology adoption is human-centric across all organizational levels.
